article_title: ChatGPT Agent 循环优化：Harness、API 与推理层的三层提效实践
core_theme: ChatGPT Agent 三层架构（Harness/API/Inference）如何通过避免重复工作来降低单次任务成本
reader_takeaway: 理解 agentic AI 应用的三层架构，以及每层具体用了哪些优化技术来降低延迟和成本
summary_angle: 三层协同、各司其职：Harness 不再重复发、API 不再重复处理、推理层不再重复计算——避免为同一件事付两次钱

information_blocks.source_anchor: Harness 层：持久 WebSocket + 增量请求 + 稳定前缀 + Code Mode
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一个精简的数据包通过持久连接向前推进，旧载荷被剪掉

information_blocks.source_anchor: API 层：只 tokenize 增量 + 安全检测与推理并行
information_blocks.visual_idea: 两条并行轨道同时推进，一条推理一条安全检测

information_blocks.source_anchor: 推理层：缓存感知路由 + KV Cache 管理 + 推测解码 + Prefill/Decode 分离
information_blocks.visual_idea: GPU 集群中请求被路由回已有缓存状态的机器

main_metaphor: 一条三层流水线，每层都有特定的减重/加速手段，请求从大包变成精简增量、从串行变并行、从随机路由变精准命中

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: How ChatGPT's three-layer agent architecture (Harness, API, Inference) reduces cost per task by avoiding repeated work at each layer. The reader should quickly feel the efficiency gains from layered optimization.

Summary angle: Three layers working in concert: Harness stops resending redundant data, API stops reprocessing redundant work, Inference stops recomputing redundant state — never pay twice for the same work.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject (a three-stage pipeline structure) and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.

Information blocks:
- mechanism: Harness layer uses persistent WebSocket + incremental requests + stable prefixes. Visual: a streamlined data packet pushing forward through a persistent connection, old payload stripped away. Label: 只发增量
- mechanism: API layer tokenizes only the delta and runs safety checks in parallel with inference. Visual: two parallel tracks running simultaneously, one inference, one safety check. Label: 并行检测
- mechanism: Inference layer uses cache-aware routing + KV cache management + speculative decoding. Visual: requests being routed back to machines that already hold cached state. Label: 缓存路由

Main metaphor: A three-stage pipeline where each stage has a unique acceleration mechanism — data shrinks from heavy payloads to lean deltas, processing shifts from serial to parallel, routing goes from random to cache-aware.
Subject: An abstract three-layer pipeline structure with distinct visual symbols at each stage, data flowing top-to-bottom and left-to-right, becoming leaner and faster at each transition.
Composition/framing: Diagonal forward progression (top-to-bottom, left-to-right pipeline flow). Prefer horizontal storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.

Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with the selected visual style descriptor: high-energy battle comic look, strong silhouettes, speed lines, impact framing, bold contrast without excessive clutter. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.

Color palette: deep blue-gray, warm orange, bright white.

Visible text policy: allow only 3 short Chinese labels (只发增量, 并行检测, 缓存路由) sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.

Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.

Avoid: floating chips, code rain, neon skyscrapers, generic robots, HUD overlays, fake dashboards, fake architecture node names.
